title: Slot within a zone
statement: For each natural number $i$, set $B_i=2(2^i-1)$ and assign index $s$ the zone index $I(s)=\lfloor\log_2(s/2+1)\rfloor$, with integer division understood. Let $w$ assign a finite list of optional Boolean values to each of $\ell$ indices. For any index $i<\ell$ and any natural number $p<2\cdot 2^i$, the entry at position $B_i+p$ in the slot assignment is exactly the entry at position $p$ of the list assigned by $w$ to index $i$, with an out-of-range list position interpreted as absent.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a list to each of $\ell$ indices
